name: Product is one row per product despite its attribute joins
note: Orderfacts and Cashflowplan join this cube many_to_one, which makes Cube TRUST m_product_id as unique. That trust is exactly what made Businesspartner inflate Invoices 126x when its key was false. The attribute joins - M_AttributeInstance and M_AttributeValue - are the same shape that broke Businesspartner, and were verified unique by hand (273,367/273,367, worst product 1 row) before the direction was switched. This holds that verification.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM m_product WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
